goal: Set up a review queue for human labeling of agent replies for safety, citation, and tone.

expected_steps.interaction: input form (Aria needs information): enter name + questions from review-queues/agent-reply-review.queue.json, then Approve
input form for trace_ids (enqueue.json; queue_id is linked from review_queue.create) OR Skip step (queue-first, enqueue-later)

notes: Both steps come from the single domain 'review_queue' (the needle 'review queue' in the goal). review_queue.create raises an input interaction for name + questions; add_items' queue_id is linked (depends_on = [review_queue.create]) so its input interaction asks for trace_ids only. Under autonomy=ask_each each step also raises an Approve/Deny permission interaction. Skipping or denying add_items marks that step skipped; the queue from review_queue.create still exists.
